description: A photograph depicting an agroforestry landscape, likely a *dehesa* or *montado* from the Mediterranean area. The foreground is dominated by a field of green grass with interspersed patches of lighter, yellowish-green vegetation, possibly indicating flowering plants or varying grassland density. In the midground and background, numerous broadleaf trees with dense, dark green canopies are scattered across the terrain. These trees are consistent with *Quercus* species (oaks), which are characteristic of dehesa systems. The sky is bright but overcast, creating soft lighting.
